","pt":"## Chapter 1: Topological Structure & Mathematical Foundations of Tile Match 3

Welcome to the **Puzzle PK Master Class Guide for Sheep A Sheep (Tile Match 3)**. Beneath its accessible and vibrant exterior lies a profound mathematical challenge grounded in **Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)** topology, spatial combinatorial optimization, and buffer constraint management. By mastering structured layer reading, you will transform chaotic guessing into surgical victory!

### 1.1 AABB Spatial Occlusion & Topological Precedence
Each tile occupies a discrete $2 \times 2$ grid unit on a 2D plane and carries an integer layer depth $Z \in \{0, 1, 2, \dots, L\}$.
- **Occlusion Definition**: Tile $B$ directly blocks tile $A$ if and only if:
  $$Z_B > Z_A \quad \text{and} \quad |X_A - X_B| < 2 \quad \text{and} \quad |Y_A - Y_B| < 2$$
- **Dependency Chains**: As long as any tile $B$ lies above $A$, tile $A$ is in a locked, darkened state. In graph theory, this represents a directed edge $B \to A$. Players can only harvest root nodes that currently have an in-degree of 0 (fully exposed top tiles).

### 1.2 Conservation of Multiples of 3 & Solvability
Unlike unscrupulous games that spawn impossible configurations to force ad impressions, Puzzle PK guarantees fair play:
- **Symbol Conservation**: The total count $C(T_k)$ for every symbol $T_k$ strictly satisfies:
  $$C(T_k) \equiv 0 \pmod 3$$
- **Deduction**: The grand total of all tiles is always a clean multiple of 3. Mathematically, no puzzle is generated in an unsolvable dead end; failure results solely from suboptimal tray-scheduling decisions under the 7-slot constraint!

---

## Chapter 2: The Three Strategic Zones of the Board

Master players divide the playing field into three distinct architectural sectors:

### 2.1 The Deep Central Pyramid (Main Well)
- **Characteristics**: Located dead-center, containing the vast majority of layers (up to 8 layers in Hard mode).
- **Tactical Value**: **The primary objective of the entire game!** Over 70% of total tiles are buried here. If you fail to tunnel downward systematically, deep subterranean tiles will remain inaccessible forever. Every move must ultimately aim to unblock the central well!

### 2.2 Peripheral Spread Wings
- **Characteristics**: Flat, wide arrays surrounding the main pyramid, usually only 1-2 layers deep.
- **Tactical Value**: **Your strategic safety buffer.** Because these tiles have few underlying blockers, removing them carries almost zero risk of uncovering dead ends. Save them as \"Balancing Keys\" to complete triplets when the center is blocked!

### 2.3 Side Blocker Stacks
- **Characteristics**: Horizontally overlapping blind stacks on the edges where only the top tile is visible.
- **Tactical Value**: **High hazard zone!** Never dig blindly into the side stacks unless you have ample tray space, as uncovered random symbols can easily flood your slots.

---

## Chapter 3: The Four Golden Tray Management Commandments

With only 7 slots in your tray, buffer discipline is the difference between triumph and instant defeat:

### Commandment 1: The Strict "3-Tile Safety Ceiling"
- Never allow more than 3 mismatched, idle tiles in your tray simultaneously!
- The remaining 4 empty slots represent your vital breathing room. If your tray already holds 4-5 orphan tiles, stop immediately and seek an urgent match!

### Commandment 2: Never Harvest Without a Path to Three
- Inexperienced players grab any available tile. Soon their tray is clogged with 5 different singletons.
- **Master Rule**: Before picking up tile #1, your eyes must already locate tile #2 and tile #3 on the board. If the third tile is buried deep underground, do not commit!

### Commandment 3: Mine the Center, Balance with the Wings
- Always prioritize clearing tiles that expose deeper layers in the main pyramid.
- Only tap peripheral wing tiles when you need an immediate match-3 to rescue an overcrowded tray.

### Commandment 4: The Look-Ahead Principle
- Before picking up an exposed tile, inspect the exposed corners of the tile beneath it.
- If removing it directly reveals a twin you urgently need, it is a high-value double-win play!

---

## Chapter 4: Precision Deployment of the Three Power-Ups

Your three power-ups represent three extra lives:

### 4.1 Stash (Move Out) —— The Tray Expander
- **Effect**: Shifts the leftmost 3 tiles from your tray onto an auxiliary shelf.
- **Optimal Timing**: **When your tray reaches 5-6 tiles and you face an imminent game over!** It instantly expands your operational capacity to 10 effective slots.

### 4.2 Undo —— The Reconnaissance Probe
- **Effect**: Returns the last placed tile back to its exact board coordinates.
- **Optimal Timing**: Use it to probe what lies beneath a high-priority tile. If the underlying tile is useless, immediately tap Undo at zero penalty!

### 4.3 Shuffle —— The Chaos Breaker
- **Effect**: Randomly scrambles the symbols of all remaining board tiles.
- **Optimal Timing**: Deploy when all exposed tiles are completely mismatched and your tray cannot accommodate further experimentation.

---

## Chapter 5: Step-by-Step Endgame Walkthrough

Suppose your tray holds: `[Carrot, Carrot, Bell, Wheat, Sheep]` (5 slots filled — Critical Danger!):
1. **Step 1 (Hunt for the Finisher)**: Is there a Carrot visible anywhere on the board?
   - If yes, grab it immediately! The 3-match triggers, dumping 3 tiles and dropping your tray to `[Bell, Wheat, Sheep]` (3 tiles — Safe Zone restored!).
2. **Step 2 (Emergency Protocol)**: If no Carrot is accessible:
   - Check if a Bell or Wheat can be completed in 1 move.
   - If impossible, press <kbd>1</kbd> to trigger **Stash**, moving the first 3 tiles out and instantly regaining full control!

---

## Chapter 6: Multiplayer Real-Time Speed PK Tactics

In Puzzle PK 1v1 battles, both players share the **exact same pseudo-random seed**:
- **Symmetric Battlefield**: Both players face identical pyramid layouts and symbol distributions.
- **Mental Pressure**: Audio combo chimes and rapid score gains exert psychological pressure on your opponent.
- **Speed with Precision**: The winner is whoever executes zero-overflow clearances with the highest APM!

---

## Chapter 7: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Why is a bottom tile still dark even after I picked up a tile over it?
A: A single tile can be overlapped by up to 4 different upper tiles across its corners! It only unlocks when **all** overlying tiles have been cleared.

### Q: Does Undo bring back cleared tiles?
A: No. Undo strictly acts upon the last non-cleared tile currently resting in your tray. Matches that have already burst are permanent achievements!

Each tile occupies a discrete $2 \times 2$ grid unit on a 2D plane and carries an integer layer depth $Z \in \{0, 1, 2, \dots, L\}$.
- **Occlusion Definition**: Tile $B$ directly blocks tile $A$ if and only if:
  $$Z_B > Z_A \quad \text{and} \quad |X_A - X_B| < 2 \quad \text{and} \quad |Y_A - Y_B| < 2$$
- **Dependency Chains**: As long as any tile $B$ lies above $A$, tile $A$ is in a locked, darkened state. In graph theory, this represents a directed edge $B \to A$. Players can only harvest root nodes that currently have an in-degree of 0 (fully exposed top tiles).

### 1.2 Conservation of Multiples of 3 & Solvability
Unlike unscrupulous games that spawn impossible configurations to force ad impressions, Puzzle PK guarantees fair play:
- **Symbol Conservation**: The total count $C(T_k)$ for every symbol $T_k$ strictly satisfies:
  $$C(T_k) \equiv 0 \pmod 3$$
- **Deduction**: The grand total of all tiles is always a clean multiple of 3. Mathematically, no puzzle is generated in an unsolvable dead end; failure results solely from suboptimal tray-scheduling decisions under the 7-slot constraint!

## Chapter 2: The Three Strategic Zones of the Board

Master players divide the playing field into three distinct architectural sectors:

### 2.1 The Deep Central Pyramid (Main Well)
- **Characteristics**: Located dead-center, containing the vast majority of layers (up to 8 layers in Hard mode).
- **Tactical Value**: **The primary objective of the entire game!** Over 70% of total tiles are buried here. If you fail to tunnel downward systematically, deep subterranean tiles will remain inaccessible forever. Every move must ultimately aim to unblock the central well!

### 2.2 Peripheral Spread Wings
- **Characteristics**: Flat, wide arrays surrounding the main pyramid, usually only 1-2 layers deep.
- **Tactical Value**: **Your strategic safety buffer.** Because these tiles have few underlying blockers, removing them carries almost zero risk of uncovering dead ends. Save them as \"Balancing Keys\" to complete triplets when the center is blocked!

### 2.3 Side Blocker Stacks
- **Characteristics**: Horizontally overlapping blind stacks on the edges where only the top tile is visible.
- **Tactical Value**: **High hazard zone!** Never dig blindly into the side stacks unless you have ample tray space, as uncovered random symbols can easily flood your slots.

## Chapter 3: The Four Golden Tray Management Commandments

With only 7 slots in your tray, buffer discipline is the difference between triumph and instant defeat:

### Commandment 1: The Strict "3-Tile Safety Ceiling"
- Never allow more than 3 mismatched, idle tiles in your tray simultaneously!
- The remaining 4 empty slots represent your vital breathing room. If your tray already holds 4-5 orphan tiles, stop immediately and seek an urgent match!

### Commandment 2: Never Harvest Without a Path to Three
- Inexperienced players grab any available tile. Soon their tray is clogged with 5 different singletons.
- **Master Rule**: Before picking up tile #1, your eyes must already locate tile #2 and tile #3 on the board. If the third tile is buried deep underground, do not commit!

### Commandment 3: Mine the Center, Balance with the Wings
- Always prioritize clearing tiles that expose deeper layers in the main pyramid.
- Only tap peripheral wing tiles when you need an immediate match-3 to rescue an overcrowded tray.

### Commandment 4: The Look-Ahead Principle
- Before picking up an exposed tile, inspect the exposed corners of the tile beneath it.
- If removing it directly reveals a twin you urgently need, it is a high-value double-win play!

## Chapter 4: Precision Deployment of the Three Power-Ups

Your three power-ups represent three extra lives:

### 4.1 Stash (Move Out) —— The Tray Expander
- **Effect**: Shifts the leftmost 3 tiles from your tray onto an auxiliary shelf.
- **Optimal Timing**: **When your tray reaches 5-6 tiles and you face an imminent game over!** It instantly expands your operational capacity to 10 effective slots.

### 4.2 Undo —— The Reconnaissance Probe
- **Effect**: Returns the last placed tile back to its exact board coordinates.
- **Optimal Timing**: Use it to probe what lies beneath a high-priority tile. If the underlying tile is useless, immediately tap Undo at zero penalty!

### 4.3 Shuffle —— The Chaos Breaker
- **Effect**: Randomly scrambles the symbols of all remaining board tiles.
- **Optimal Timing**: Deploy when all exposed tiles are completely mismatched and your tray cannot accommodate further experimentation.

Suppose your tray holds: `[Carrot, Carrot, Bell, Wheat, Sheep]` (5 slots filled — Critical Danger!):
1. **Step 1 (Hunt for the Finisher)**: Is there a Carrot visible anywhere on the board?
   - If yes, grab it immediately! The 3-match triggers, dumping 3 tiles and dropping your tray to `[Bell, Wheat, Sheep]` (3 tiles — Safe Zone restored!).
2. **Step 2 (Emergency Protocol)**: If no Carrot is accessible:
   - Check if a Bell or Wheat can be completed in 1 move.
   - If impossible, press <kbd>1</kbd> to trigger **Stash**, moving the first 3 tiles out and instantly regaining full control!

## Chapter 7: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Why is a bottom tile still dark even after I picked up a tile over it?
A: A single tile can be overlapped by up to 4 different upper tiles across its corners! It only unlocks when **all** overlying tiles have been cleared.

### Q: Does Undo bring back cleared tiles?
A: No. Undo strictly acts upon the last non-cleared tile currently resting in your tray. Matches that have already burst are permanent achievements!
